text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Squared error of each calibrated anomaly against the CAMS anomaly, divided by ENS's, in each held- out month of the training window (cross-validation: all calibrations fitted on the other months). Rule at 1: same as ENS. Daylight April-to-September rows at leads of 0 to 240 hours, five Primary substations. Pooled over the months: GEFS 1.109, blend 1.002; the blend needed 0.99.'
text.tspan: Squared error of each calibrated anomaly against the CAMS anomaly, divided by ENS's, in each held-
out month of the training window (cross-validation: all calibrations fitted on the other months).
Rule at 1: same as ENS. Daylight April-to-September rows at leads of 0 to 240 hours, five Primary
substations. Pooled over the months: GEFS 1.109, blend 1.002; the blend needed 0.99.
